priceSnapshot.note: Spot 77,353.3 at the 11:59Z minute bar. The 0.41 percent change is measured against the settled 11:00Z hourly close of 24 hours ago, 77,034.7, not against a ticker field - the OKX /market/ticker endpoint has repeatedly returned cached payloads through this run's proxy and is not used. The 24h high of 79,896.3 and low of 76,001.0 still both belong to Thursday's CPI candle. Today's own candle is open 77,223.5, high 77,405.0, low 77,171.9: a 233.1-point range, 0.30 percent, against a daily ATR of 2,193.49. That is roughly one tenth of a normal day and it is the SECOND consecutive session of this compression.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,000.0, 353.3 points under spot. This is the third consecutive session this floor has been published and the third it has gone untested - the lowest settled hourly close since the midnight mark is 77,216.7 at 05:00Z and the lowest wick is 77,171.9, both clear of it. It matters more this morning than it did at midnight because the daily EMA20 has risen to 77,050.2 and now sits INSIDE the same band: losing 77,000.0 on a settled close forfeits the daily EMA20 and the 1,868,002 USD long-liquidation cluster in one move, and the only measured reference underneath is 76,001.0.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,669.9, the 4H EMA20, 316.6 points over spot. The gate steps DOWN from midnight's 77,708.8 only because the 4H EMA20 itself has fallen 38.9 points; the logic is unchanged and deliberately conservative. It sits above the 1H EMA50 at 77,515.5, above the 4H EMA100 at 77,564.3 and above the 77,375 to 77,625 short-liquidation band, so a settled close through it clears every overhead average that has capped price since 08 September in a single event. It is also the level that invalidates the open futures short.

decisionBox.changed: The published stance does not change - spot core HOLD, futures short live from midnight - but two things underneath it moved, and they point in OPPOSITE directions, which is why confidence stays at 5.50 rather than rising. Against the short: momentum stopped deteriorating. The 1H MACD histogram has turned positive at plus 13.52 with the line lifting from minus 54.34 to minus 40.83, the 4H histogram is plus 39.48, and funding collapsed from plus 0.0000925535 to plus 0.0000306030, a 67 percent drop, so longs are barely paying now. Price also closed back above the 1H EMA20 at 77,343.5 and took the day high to 77,405.0. For the short: the OKX long/short account ratio printed a NEW high of 1.67 at the 11:00Z bar, up from midnight's 1.64, and it has climbed every hour since 06:00Z - 1.64, 1.65, 1.66, 1.67, 1.67, 1.67. Crucially it did so while open interest went nowhere: swap OI is 2,122,746,822 USD against midnight's 2,122,897,548, minus 0.007 percent, and aggregate BTC OI actually fell 0.26 percent from the 07:00Z bar. More accounts are long, with no more money behind them. That is retail crowding without size - the posture that gets run, not the posture that pushes. Neither of midnight's gates fired: the 77,000.0 reduce gate held with 171.9 points of wick room and the 77,708.8 add gate missed by 303.8 points on the high. With the trade already on and both gates intact, the correct action is to manage it, not to re-enter it.

liquidation.note: 1,868,002 USD of filled long liquidations across 62 fills in the 250-point band centred on 77,000 - 83 percent of all measured long-side fuel in the window and by far the largest cluster. It now overlaps the daily EMA20 at 77,050.2 and the published reduce gate, so one settled close breaks three things at once.
251,297 USD across 9 fills, 249,356 of it long-side. First shelf under spot; today's session low of 77,262.7 sits on its upper edge, which is part of why the day has held.

155,412 USD across 8 fills, ALL short-side - the entire measured short-side fuel above price sits in this one band. The 1H EMA50 at 77,515.5 sits inside it, so a squeeze through here would be mechanically self-feeding for a few hundred points.
121,890 USD across 21 fills, all long-side. Thin next to the 77,000 band, and the shelf itself was cut through by 749 points on 10 September, so treat it as damaged rather than as support.

liquidityMagnet.note: Freshness caveat, stated plainly: the newest fill in the buffer is stamped 07:08:59Z and is therefore 4 hours 51 minutes old at the time of writing, though it IS newer than the 03:27:10Z record midnight read, so a handful of new liquidations have printed since. The near-zero print rate is itself the message - in two full sessions almost nobody has been forced out in either direction, which is what a genuine compression looks like. The asymmetry it measures is unchanged and large: 2,239,248 USD long-side against 157,352 USD short-side, 14.2 to 1, with every long band beneath price and the whole short side in one band overhead. Pull reads down on that imbalance and on the account ratio making a new high at 1.67, not on any burst of fresh flow this morning.

etfFlows.note: Farside Investors US spot Bitcoin ETF tape, re-read in-page 2026-09-12T07:02 COT. No new row - the desk is shut for the weekend and the last settled session is still 11 September. The negative streak stands at FOUR: 08 Sep minus 46.6, 09 Sep minus 120.2, 10 Sep minus 282.7, 11 Sep minus 13.2, totalling minus 462.7 million. The shape remains the one constructive detail - 46.6, then 120.2, then 282.7, then a collapse to 13.2, a 95 percent deceleration on the final day without an actual turn.
